details: For finite concept classes; unlabeled stable compression is a restricted form of labeled stable compression.
proof: Forgetting labels from a compression set is an additional restriction. Thus every stable unlabeled scheme is a stable labeled scheme, and the minimum stable-unlabeled size is at least the stable-labeled one.
witness_verification: On the full n-cube, stable unlabeled compression is n and stable labeled compression is $\lceil n/2\rceil$, by the database-owned value proofs. Thus the inequality is strict for $n\ge2$. The ratio is bounded by two; this is not an unbounded-ratio witness. It localizes the full-cube separation of stable unlabeled compression from projected NCTD to this edge, not the stable-labeled/projected-NCTD edge.
name: Stable Unlabeled Complexity / Stable Labeled Sample Compression
